tasks.final_text: Today I took Mr Darcy to the vet. We have been very worried about what is causing his hind leg weakness and possible pain. He was having so much trouble about a month ago, and has significantly improved on steroids, but we don't have a diagnosis yet for what is going on. The vet really didn't have a good idea either, so he recommended we do repeat blood work to look at his values.

The national Mueseum of Galle (Galle National Mueseum) is one of the national museums of Sri Lanka. It is located in the oldest remaining Dutch building in the Galle fort, Galle, a single storey colonnaded Duth building built in 1656 as the commissariat store for the Dutch garrison at the fort.
